messages:
maya: quick sync — thinking about a short post-launch play that ties the launch post, a 30-min 'deep dive' webinar, and a small PLG experiment (200 free credits, auto-onboard prompts). goal: measurable activation + clean inbound routing.
sam: love it. timeline? :rocket:
lin: if we do credits let's gate by new signups only, 7-day expiry. prevents churny accounts.
maya: timeline: launch post 2026-03-08, webinar 2026-03-14, cohort experiment 03/08-03/22. can we route inbound leads from the post to the webinar signup form?
anya: yes — we can add utm_source=post & route to webinar funnel. I can wire the form -> SFDC lead campaign.
oliver: for onboarding prompts — propose two sets: 'templates-first' vs 'playground-first' A/B. small prompt set of 5 starter templates each.
maya: exact. want to measure activation (first successful generation) within 24h. primary metric = % activated, secondary = avg token usage.
sam: can marketing-bot push a brief benchmark blurb to the blog + a one-pager for sales?
marketing-bot: auto: created draft blog post at https://internal.redwood/marketing/drafts/post-3-8
lin: segmentation rule for credits:
```
if new_signup and utm_source == 'post' and created_at >= '2026-03-08' then grant_credits(200, expires_in=7d)
```
any compliance concerns?
anya: include TOS blurb + rate limit check. also ping security for data retention impact.
maya: can the console team add a token-level metric to dashboard for the cohort? need to track cost per activation.
oliver: yep, ops can add 'cohort=post-launch-3-8' tag on requests. will do.
sam: are we routing high-intent leads (webinar signups) to AE queue?
anya: yes — use score >= 70, route to AE queue, otherwise nurture drips.
maya: assign actions:
- anya: set up form + SFDC campaign + lead routing
- lin: implement credit grant rule + TOS text
- oliver: add cohort tag + dashboard metric
- sam: finalize blog draft + sales one-pager
- maya: confirm webinar slides + runbook

maya: aiming to launch this Wednesday. quick thumbs if you're aligned :thumbsup:
sam: :thumbsup:
lin: :thumbsup:
anya: :thumbsup:
oliver: :thumbsup:
